title: Imantat Ist’irinaka, Khitinakatix Iyaw sapkäna ukanaka
intro: Mä qullan tantachäwin amuktʼatapanxa, mä muspharkañ tantachäwiw jan uñjat chiqat purinïna. Kunatï muspharkañäki uka tuqit jiskhtʼasisaw istʼapxäna, ukat wiñayatakiw destinopar sellañapäna. Jupanakan qhanañchäwipax Diosan qillqatanakapat sipansa jukʼamp mayjawa.
clues: Jiwasax mä reino ukankir jaqinakätanwa, ukax jilpachanix janiw uñjapkiti, ukat mä tamaw jutapxta.
Mä jachʼa tantachäwiruw sarapjjta, mä muspharkañ istʼañataki.
Ukar puripkta ukhajja, mä recitación istʼapjjayäta, ukajj wal muspharayitäna.
Jiwasat yaqhepajj cheqapar sarnaqerïpjjewa, yaqhepasti jan cheqapar sarnaqerïpjjatap qhan amuyapjjta.
Aka Uraqin Diosan kamachipat janiw qhispiñjamäkiti, janirakiw alaxpachar tʼijtʼasas qhispiñjamäkiti, uk yatipxayätwa.
Irnaqawi ist’asax iyawsapxayätwa; khititix Tatitupar iyawski ukax janiw chhaqtäwisa, q'ipirus axsarkaniti.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
verse: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways. (72:11)
